backendNote: uv_build 0.12.9 -- MANDATES PEP 621 [project] and requires Python >=3.8, comfortably below this family. Runs at the current latest release, not a rolled-back one.
packageManagerNote: uv 0.12.9 runs here at the current latest, not a rollback. Verified in-session: `uv venv` succeeds, `uv pip install` resolves, `uv lock` produces a lockfile, and `uv python install 3.9` installs a managed CPython 3.9.23 in seconds. uv also drives the poetry-core branches on this family, because poetry-core 2.2.1 emits PEP 621 -- the one thing that blocked that pairing on the earlier families.

toolsActiveDetail.note: crosshair-tool 0.0.110 declares >=3.8 but its real floor is 3.9. On the 3.8 family it installed, `import crosshair` succeeded, and the tool then died on invocation with TypeError: 'ABCMeta' object is not subscriptable -- crosshair/libimpl/builtinslib.py subscripts collections.abc.Mapping, which is PEP 585. PEP 585 is 3.9, so here that module imports and the tool runs. The declared floor was wrong by exactly one minor version, and only invoking it ever showed that.
radon 6.0.1 declares no Requires-Python and imports cleanly on 3.8.
lizard 1.24.0 -- a silent import crash on the 3.6 family, working from 3.7 onward. Agrees with radon exactly: CCN 21 = CC 21.
Not a PyPI package -- no distribution of that name exists. Implemented here as a stdlib `ast` cognitive-complexity scorer, written 3.6-compatible, so it runs everywhere in this corpus including here.
jscpd 5.1.1 is an npm package that runs on Node, not on the project interpreter, so the Python version is irrelevant to it. Verified in-session: found the planted clone pair in Python sources.
cosmic-ray 8.7.0 declares >=3.9. Mutation Score gets a primary for the first time in the corpus; mutmut, its alternative, needs 3.10.
beniget 0.5.0 declares >=3.6 and means it. Needs gast 0.7.0.

pydriller 2.10 works. It declared >=3.5 and lied on both previous families, crashing on a walrus operator at pydriller/utils/mailmap.py:72 -- the walrus is 3.8. Verified here by execution, not by import.
ruff 0.16.5 -- alternative for 19 of the 103 metrics. Dark on 3.6, live from 3.7 onward.
complexipy 7.0.1 declares >=3.8. It is the alternative for all seven Cognitive Complexity metrics, which until this family had cognitive-ast as primary and no cross-check whatsoever.

vulture 2.16 declares >=3.9. Dead Data Identification gets its alternative, but pylint (its partner in the roster entry 'pylint + vulture') is dark until 3.10.
